
# Calculator Hub

> Calculator Hub is an online calculator website designed to help users perform common calculations quickly and conveniently.

## Website

- Homepage: /
- Available calculators: /#calculators
- Contact: /#contact

## About

Calculator Hub provides browser-based tools for everyday calculations, including age and health-related calculations where available.

## Usage

Use the website's public pages to explore available calculators. Results are intended for general informational purposes and should be checked when accuracy is important.
